description: Preview first, 30-day undo. Canonicalize one owned duplicate calendar pair: copy fields unique to the archived event onto keep_event_id, then recoverably archive archive_event_id (archived_at + canonical_id). Person tags stay on the archived row (restorable). Preview with preview_destructive_change({tool:"cleanup_duplicate_events",arguments:{keep_event_id,archive_event_id}}). Reviewed and reversible: first call preview_destructive_change({ tool: "cleanup_duplicate_events", arguments: { keep_event_id, archive_event_id } }), which stores the exact change without applying it. After the user confirms, call cleanup_duplicate_events with preview_id, restore_window_acknowledged: true and request_id; the reviewed preview is applied exactly and a changed record is refused. Returns restore_id; restore_change({ restore_id }) undoes it for 30 days unless the record was edited since. ($0.10; API key required)
